prompt_text: How to run a year-end fundraising campaign
aio_text:
AI Overview
Running a successful year-end campaign involves setting clear goals, creating a compelling, theme-based narrative, and launching early (by November) across multiple channels.
Key Components:
- Plan Ahead (Before Nov 1): Set SMART goals.
- Segment donors for personalized appeals.
